method: Separate author desk-review pass before Thai translation; not independent blind or human review

items.key_check: Accounting records attributable actions. A protected account/action/time record addresses the investigation; authentication and permission records alone do not show the change.
distractor_checks: A login shows authentication at that time, not which later configuration action occurred.
The role establishes authorization, not evidence that a particular account performed this change.
Inventory identifies the asset and owner, not the actor and time of the configuration change.
items.note: One bounded decision; all three alternatives checked against the stated facts and criterion.

items.key_check: Non-repudiation concerns evidence of a past action. The stated signature and supporting key evidence address the disputed approval; they are not an unconditional legal guarantee.
distractor_checks: Authentication of a current session does not by itself establish approval of a particular past order.
A signature does not hide the signed order from readers.
Signature evidence does not demonstrate service uptime or recoverability.
items.note: Signature evidence is expressly qualified by key binding/control; no legal-proof guarantee.

items.key_check: Minimization limits collection to information needed for the stated purpose. Protecting or later deleting unnecessary data does not remove the unnecessary collection.
distractor_checks: Encryption can protect confidentiality but still collects unnecessary personal data.
Access restrictions do not justify collecting fields unnecessary for joining instructions.
A deletion schedule limits duration but does not minimize initial collection.
items.note: One bounded decision; all three alternatives checked against the stated facts and criterion.

items.target: Apply a supplied ordinary retention schedule
items.key_check: The specified trigger is the end of the visit. Only 12 days have elapsed from that trigger, regardless of when the record was created.
distractor_checks: Creation time is not the trigger defined in this schedule.
Reading a record does not reset the supplied visit-end trigger.
The review date is not the retention trigger, so this would extend the defined period.
items.note: Creation, visit-end and review triggers are distinguishable; no retention exception invented.

items.target: Scope an erasure request against supplied retention obligations
items.key_check: The request must be applied by record category. The supplied retention requirement covers invoices, not the obsolete preferences.
distractor_checks: Verification establishes who requested erasure, not an override of the stated retention requirement.
The invoice requirement does not extend to preferences whose deletion is permitted.
Encryption is not erasure and does not implement the category-specific disposition.
items.note: Supplied rule resolves the category conflict without a jurisdictional claim.

items.key_check: Privacy includes appropriate use of personal data. Authorized reading, accurate values and an audit trail do not make the prohibited promotional purpose permissible.
distractor_checks: The scenario states that values did not change; it demonstrates improper use rather than altered data.
No service interruption or inability to access scheduling is stated.
The export is logged and attributed. Accountability evidence does not itself authorize the purpose.
items.note: One bounded decision; all three alternatives checked against the stated facts and criterion.

items.key_check: Identification presents a claimed identity. The stated process has not yet checked evidence that supports the claim.
distractor_checks: Knowing or entering an identifier is not the stated verification of the claimant.
No resource-permission decision has been made.
Entering an identifier at a kiosk does not establish enrollment identity-proofing evidence.
items.note: One bounded decision; all three alternatives checked against the stated facts and criterion.

items.key_check: Inherent risk excludes the effect of controls; residual risk is the exposure remaining after them. The latter need not be zero or accepted.
distractor_checks: This reverses the before-control and remaining-risk meanings.
Appetite and tolerance express organizational boundaries, not these two exposure estimates.
Neither insurance/transfer nor ending the risky activity is stated.
items.note: One bounded decision; all three alternatives checked against the stated facts and criterion.

items.key_check: 60,000 × 0.30 = 18,000 dollars for one incident. No annual occurrence rate is supplied, so this is not an annualized estimate.
distractor_checks: 6,000 is 10% of 60,000, not the supplied 30% exposure.
42,000 is the value remaining after a 30% loss, not the expected loss.
The full asset value assumes 100% loss rather than the stated exposure fraction.
items.note: One bounded decision; all three alternatives checked against the stated facts and criterion.

items.key_check: 12,000 × 0.25 = 3,000 dollars per year. It is a model-based annual expectation, not a guarantee of spending or loss in any one year.
distractor_checks: This ignores the occurrence rate and treats the single-event loss as an annual amount.
Dividing by 0.25 reverses the required annualization; the given rate must be multiplied.
The amount is annualized; the supplied loss per event remains 12,000 dollars.
items.note: One bounded decision; all three alternatives checked against the stated facts and criterion.

items.key_check: B meets the stated constraint and its estimated reduction exceeds its cost by 1,000 dollars over the same year. A has a larger net estimate but fails the binding requirement.
distractor_checks: A favorable estimate does not authorize ignoring a binding internal requirement.
Complete risk elimination is not a prerequisite for a defensible treatment choice.
Relative price alone ignores mandatory capabilities and the positive supplied benefit of B.
items.note: Annual values share units/horizon; mandatory logging makes B the sole compliant offered treatment.

items.key_check: The supplied matrix and treatment policy prioritize B. Finding counts alone do not determine the assessed business risk.
distractor_checks: The policy uses likelihood and impact, not the raw number of findings.
Equal likelihood does not erase the stated difference in business impact.
The approved qualitative matrix supports this priority without monetary estimates.
items.note: Explicit matrix controls priority; no unsupported arithmetic on ordinal scores.

items.key_check: Observed control ineffectiveness challenges the assumed reduction. Monitoring should update residual-risk assessment and treatment, not equate installation with effectiveness.
distractor_checks: Installation alone does not demonstrate that the intended risk-reduction objective is met.
Changing an ownership entry does not address the observed failure of the control.
Acceptance requires appropriate authority; the failed test does not itself grant an exception.
items.note: One bounded decision; all three alternatives checked against the stated facts and criterion.

items.key_check: A procedure specifies operational steps. It implements the standard rather than replacing the mandatory requirement.
distractor_checks: A policy supplies direction and purpose rather than the requested operational sequence.
The requirement already exists; repeating it does not provide the implementation steps.
Optional recommendations do not supply the required operational procedure.
items.note: One bounded decision; all three alternatives checked against the stated facts and criterion.

items.key_check: The mandatory standard governs this configuration. A nonbinding guideline does not create an exception.
distractor_checks: The guideline's subject does not override the mandatory length requirement.
Users are not given authority to waive the mandatory standard.
An arbitrary midpoint still fails the stated 14-character minimum.
items.note: One bounded decision; all three alternatives checked against the stated facts and criterion.

items.key_check: Applicability is explicitly supplied. Voluntary framework outcomes and a vendor suggestion do not displace that requirement.
distractor_checks: A product recommendation does not override the stated applicable regulation.
Popularity does not itself create the obligation excluded by the scenario.
The scenario distinguishes an applicable requirement from two nonbinding sources.
items.note: One bounded decision; all three alternatives checked against the stated facts and criterion.

items.target: Compliance does not establish complete security
items.key_check: A scoped compliance result does not establish complete security. The new evidence must be evaluated on its own merits.
distractor_checks: A finding outside the checklist is not accepted merely by passing that checklist.
Additional risk does not by itself disprove tests that were valid within their stated scope.
Risk management is not limited to risks already enumerated in a compliance checklist.
items.note: One bounded decision; all three alternatives checked against the stated facts and criterion.

items.key_check: The specified purpose is discovering and reporting entry. The separate lock performs the described access prevention.
distractor_checks: The sensor does not block entry or change permission in this scenario.
The sensor reports an event rather than restoring a damaged state.
The sensor detects activity rather than instructing people how to behave.
items.note: One bounded decision; all three alternatives checked against the stated facts and criterion.

items.target: Compensating control with an explicit constraint
items.key_check: The approved alternative addresses the same entry-control objective while the preferred mechanism is unavailable; effectiveness still requires monitoring.
distractor_checks: Entry remains controlled; the organization has not simply accepted unrestricted access.
The attendant also verifies authorization and controls entry, so logging is not the only objective.
The exception is temporary and does not establish that the repair requirement has ended.
items.note: One bounded decision; all three alternatives checked against the stated facts and criterion.

items.target: One control can have different functions
items.key_check: Control functions depend on use. Denying entry prevents the specified access, while reviewing records discovers attempted violations.
distractor_checks: This reverses enforcement at entry and later discovery from records.
Neither stated task restores damage, and one product can perform different functions.
Being governed by policy does not make every implemented function directive.
items.note: One bounded decision; all three alternatives checked against the stated facts and criterion.

items.key_check: Prompt authorized escalation addresses potential public harm while enabling coordinated action. The canon does not grant unrestricted disclosure or unsafe operational authority.
distractor_checks: The credible urgent safety risk warrants the available escalation rather than routine delay.
Public disclosure is not the stated authorized response and may increase risk before coordination.
Uncoordinated disabling could itself harm emergency access and exceeds the stated escalation role.
items.note: One bounded decision; all three alternatives checked against the stated facts and criterion.

items.key_check: Truthful reporting avoids a false assurance claim while making the remaining work visible. A deadline does not justify misrepresenting evidence.
distractor_checks: An expected result is not evidence that the test occurred.
Concealing a material unfinished test would misrepresent the report's coverage.
Historical results do not establish current test completion.
items.note: One bounded decision; all three alternatives checked against the stated facts and criterion.

items.key_check: Competent service includes recognizing limits and obtaining suitable expertise within the engagement. This protects the client without pretending expertise or abandoning the work.
distractor_checks: Familiarity with a different checklist does not establish competence in the required specialized method.
Reading a summary does not substantiate the expert capability being claimed.
The scenario provides a route to competent delivery; immediate withdrawal ignores that available option.
items.note: One bounded decision; all three alternatives checked against the stated facts and criterion.

items.key_check: Authorized knowledge sharing and peer learning support professional development while respecting the client's confidentiality limits.
distractor_checks: Instructional value does not override the explicit confidentiality restriction.
Naming the client violates the supplied restriction and is unnecessary for the approved lesson.
The client already permits a useful generalized lesson; waiting for unrestricted disclosure is unnecessary to share it responsibly.
items.note: Replaced weak credential-advertising distractor with excessive disclosure-delay reasoning.

items.key_check: The changed denominator excludes failures in July. Comparable cohorts and definitions are needed before interpreting the trend.
distractor_checks: A common display unit does not make different inclusion rules comparable.
Averaging the displayed percentages does not repair the changed populations.
Closed counts alone still omit the due population and overdue open findings.
items.note: One bounded decision; all three alternatives checked against the stated facts and criterion.

items.key_check: An identifier has meaning within a scope. Equal display strings across independent namespaces do not establish entity linkage.
distractor_checks: Local usernames are not stated to be globally unique.
Independent namespaces can legitimately contain the same identifier string.
A name match establishes neither common ownership nor an approved permission assignment.
items.note: One bounded decision; all three alternatives checked against the stated facts and criterion.

items.key_check: NIST distinguishes the credential binding from the authenticator used to demonstrate control. It is not universally just a username/password pair.
distractor_checks: The authenticator is the controlled secret or device, not the binding described here.
An authorization policy governs permitted resource actions, not this identity-to-authenticator binding.
An audit event records an action; it is not the identity binding being defined.
items.note: Explicitly NIST-framed binding; controlled authenticator and credential record are distinct.

items.target: Approved provisioning scope versus copying a peer
items.key_check: The initial grant should implement the new analyst's approved needs. A peer's legitimate additional duty does not extend this authorization.
distractor_checks: This would include an exception outside the new analyst's approved duties.
A later review does not authorize an unnecessary initial grant.
Account sharing would not implement the approved individual provisioning.
items.note: One bounded decision; all three alternatives checked against the stated facts and criterion.

items.key_check: The supplied risk classifications determine the routine cadence. Event-driven review complements rather than cancels that schedule.
distractor_checks: A familiar interval does not override the explicit monthly requirement for high-risk roles.
This ignores both stated routine review intervals.
Initial approval and event-driven updates do not replace required recurring reviews.
items.note: One bounded decision; all three alternatives checked against the stated facts and criterion.

items.target: ACL is an enforcement mechanism, not always DAC
items.key_check: An ACL can implement policy decisions. Determining the decision model requires evidence of who may grant rights and under what rules.
distractor_checks: A list of permissions does not by itself prove owner discretion over grants.
No mandatory classification or clearance rule is supplied.
The representation alone does not show that a job-role assignment policy generated it.
items.note: One bounded decision; all three alternatives checked against the stated facts and criterion.

items.target: Prospective scope of a group-wide permission change
items.key_check: The grant is made to the shared group and applies to every member under the explicitly limited model. It is not an individual exception.
distractor_checks: The proposed grant targets the group, not the requester alone.
Existing members also receive the group's changed permission.
Editing a grant does not make the administrator its sole beneficiary.
items.note: Fixed flat-group model excludes grant-precedence ambiguity; prospective scope differs from mover cleanup.

items.key_check: Time-bounded elevation constrains the duration of privilege while preserving ordinary work. It implements the stated policy without treating all access as temporary.
distractor_checks: A quarterly review cannot enforce the specified 30-minute end time.
This would remove ordinary access that the scenario says must remain.
Stopping voluntary use does not end the elevated permission as required.
items.note: One bounded decision; all three alternatives checked against the stated facts and criterion.

items.key_check: All three required conditions are true. Satisfying only some conditions is insufficient under the supplied conjunction.
distractor_checks: The managed/compliant-device condition is not satisfied.
The required Research-role condition is not satisfied.
The approved-hours condition is not satisfied.
items.note: One bounded decision; all three alternatives checked against the stated facts and criterion.

items.key_check: Routing provides inter-network packet forwarding. A multilayer device could supply it, but the stated Layer 2 switch does not.
distractor_checks: More within-subnet switching does not supply inter-subnet routing.
DNS maps names to addresses; it does not forward packets between subnets.
Address assignment does not itself provide the required forwarding path.
items.note: One bounded decision; all three alternatives checked against the stated facts and criterion.

items.key_check: UDP fits the stated datagram tradeoff. The application must provide any needed recovery and security; UDP is not a confidentiality service.
distractor_checks: The scenario explicitly does not require transport-level ordered retransmission of late samples.
TCP does not by itself supply confidentiality.
UDP provides no such delivery or timing guarantee.
items.note: No universal speed/security guarantee; loss/recovery conditions bound the transport choice.

items.key_check: Translation and authorization are different functions, even when one device implements both. The stated policy needs explicit enforcement.
distractor_checks: Address translation does not know the organization's unstated approved-service policy.
An address range does not establish which services a user is permitted to contact.
Changing translation capacity does not define or enforce service authorization.
items.note: One bounded decision; all three alternatives checked against the stated facts and criterion.

items.key_check: Obtaining the expected address completes the stated name lookup. Connection failure still needs separate reachability/service investigation.
distractor_checks: The evidence explicitly records successful resolution before the connection attempt.
A valid address answer does not demonstrate a successful connection.
A timeout alone does not determine the destination's protocol or exact cause.
items.note: One bounded decision; all three alternatives checked against the stated facts and criterion.

items.key_check: NTP supplies time synchronization. It supports correlation but alone does not establish the integrity or authenticity of every log record.
distractor_checks: Name resolution does not synchronize the server clocks.
Management counter collection does not by itself correct time settings.
Copying logs does not fix the already-stated clock disagreement.
items.note: One bounded decision; all three alternatives checked against the stated facts and criterion.

items.key_check: The specified flows are east-west traffic inside the environment. An internet-edge-only view does not necessarily observe them.
distractor_checks: Duplicating the existing observation scope does not expose internal-only flows.
Those queries do not show the internal application-to-database exchanges.
An address inventory is not observation of the required internal traffic.
items.note: One bounded decision; all three alternatives checked against the stated facts and criterion.

items.target: Policy-triggered reevaluation during ongoing resource access
items.key_check: Ongoing authorization can respond to relevant verified context changes. The surviving VPN connection does not override the explicit resource policy.
distractor_checks: Network admission is not sufficient to override the supplied reevaluation rule.
The stated rule applies during the ongoing session, not only at login.
VPN reauthentication does not implement the required resource suspension; continued access leaves the confirmed policy condition untreated.
items.note: Replaced implausible identity deletion with plausible but insufficient VPN reauthentication.

items.key_check: A community cloud serves a defined community of organizations with shared concerns. It need not be restricted to one organization's exclusive use.
distractor_checks: Exclusive use by one organization does not meet the described multi-organization community scope.
General public availability differs from the stated restriction to the consortium.
Multiple participating organizations do not by themselves establish a composition of distinct cloud infrastructures.
items.note: Removed the word community from the scenario to reduce direct answer-label cueing.

items.target: Bulk confidentiality after a shared session key is established
items.key_check: Symmetric encryption is suited to bulk confidentiality using the shared key. This choice does not replace key protection or any separately needed integrity mechanism.
distractor_checks: Hashing can support content comparison but does not conceal the plaintext stream.
Signatures support origin/integrity evidence, not confidentiality of exposed block contents.
That addresses key establishment, which is already completed and outside the requested bulk-protection role.
items.note: Shared key already established; no competing key-distribution interpretation.

items.key_check: The corresponding authenticated public key verifies a signature made with the publisher's private signing key. Verification is not decryption of confidential package content.
distractor_checks: A recipient's private key is not the public verification key corresponding to the publisher's signature.
Recipients do not need the secret signing key; distributing it would compromise signing control.
An unrelated symmetric key does not verify the publisher's public-key signature.
items.note: One bounded decision; all three alternatives checked against the stated facts and criterion.
